title: Does the sim let Brian hear the answer for himself?

criteria.claim: Listening at the tripod with room noise on, Brian can make out what the ball yells.
criteria.question: In the sim (Christmas morning, Listener: phone on the tripod, room noise on, Volume so the room sounds real), throw the ball. Could you make out what it yelled?

anchors.3: Heard something, could not tell what
